comments: Input facts: ego is a car initiator; agent1 is a responder with allowed type car or pedestrian; the backing group requires at least one reversing road user. Chosen assumptions: agent1 approaches from 16-20 m behind at 3-4 m/s, reacts when within 13-15 m, continues for 0.3-0.5 s, then brakes. Ego waits 0.6-0.9 s and reverses with throttle 0.25-0.35 for 3-4 s, then brakes. Ego reverse motion initiates the closing conflict. Distances are center-to-center, speeds are m/s, and times are seconds. Outcome intent is a conflict opportunity, without requiring collision.
